verdict.rationale: Portkey documents its own REST API (base URL https://api.portkey.ai/v1) through which gateway features such as fallbacks, retries, caching and routing are applied via headers. That covers the inference path. However, nothing shows that UI-side functions (log browsing and feedback, model catalog management, budget and rate-limit configuration, prompt management) are exposed through the API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so UI/API parity is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of a management/admin API covering UI features (logs, model catalog, budgets, prompts, configs), a published OpenAPI spec or full API reference demonstrating parity, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`
By changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers, you can quickly integrate Portkey's features into your existing setup.
